source_title: Brewers Championship Merch Has Dropped Online on the Heels of Milwaukee’s First World Series Win
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission.
The Milwaukee Brewers have claimed their first World Series championship title in team history after sweeping the Tampa Bay Devil Rays in the Fall Classic .
The Brewers defeated Tampa Bay by a score of 4-1 in Wednesday night’s Game 5 matchup.
Now, fans can pick up official Brewers World Series champions merch online, with sites offering up everything from T-shirts and baseball caps to player bobbleheads. As expected, items are selling fast online, with Brewers fans and baseball fans rushing to pick up these collectibles while they’re still in stock.
Just as New York Knicks merch sold quickly after the NBA team’s historic win in June, Brewers fans who’ve waited 57 years for this moment are eager to own a piece of merch with the title “World Series Champions” next to the franchise’s iconic “ball-in-glove” logo. Here’s a look at what’s still available as of this writing.
Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Champions Locker Room T-Shirt
This officially-licensed T-shirt declares the Brewers as World Series Champs and is part of the officially-licensed MLB collection at Fanatics. This is the same T-shirt seen on the players as they celebrated their World Series win. Choose from sizes small to 3XL. Fanatics says more than 35,000 of these T-shirts had already been sold as of press time.
Milwaukee Brewers New Era 2026 World Series Champions Locker Room Hat
More than 23,000 shoppers have picked up this hat — the same baseball cap seen on the Brewers players after they won Wednesday night’s game. The New Era hat features a curved bill and officially-licensed Brewers and MLB trophy motifs.
Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Champions Locker Room Fleece Hoodie
You can get the same World Series Champions design on this cotton blend hoodie, with oversized front pouch pockets and a drawstring hood. Fanatics has sizes small to 3XL still available online.
Jacob Misiorowski Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Champions Jersey Bust Bobblehead
Collectibles site FOCO has busts of Brewers stars like Jacob Misiorowski, who pitched 5 2/3 scoreless innings in Milwaukee’s big World Series win. Measuring approximately six inches in height, the commemorative bust sits on a wooden base and is hand-painted, ensuring a true unique piece.
Christian Yelich Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Champions Celebration Bobblehead
These player bobbleheads measure 36 inches (or three feet) in size and feature Brewers and World Series motifs throughout. Because the bobbleheads are all handcrafted and hand-painted, each one will be unique. You’ll want to act fast: Only 50 of these bobbleheads are being released, making them an instant collector’s item.
Jackson Chourio Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Champions Ring Base Bobblehead
You can also get a classic player bobblehead with Brewers stars perched on top of a World Series ring. Each bobblehead is wonderfully articulated and measures approximately 4.5 inches in height.
Jacob Misiorowski Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Champions Player Baseball
These officially-licensed baseballs have a wraparound design with Brewers colors and World Series Champions branding. Only 1,026 baseballs were released and each one is individually numbered making this a great collector’s item and conversation piece.
This is the first World Series win for the Brewers, who were founded as the Seattle Pilots in 1969. Milwaukee made their only previous World Series appearance in 1982, when the team was part of the American League. They moved to the National League in 1998.
Now, the 2026 Brew Crew has made history, bringing a World Series title to Wisconsin for the first time, while standing on the shoulders of giants like Robin Yount, Paul Molitor, and Ryan Braun.
